gaps.explanation: p6 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints four enterprise columns (Electric, Water, Sewer, Gas) with no schedule of their own; detail[] has no business-type lines. JSON receipts = total operating revenues 99,099,145 + investment income 2,107,729 + gain (loss) on sale of assets (120,574) + grant revenue 3,700 = 101,090,000 (the JSON counts the gain/loss row among receipts, so it is added as revenue here). Per column: Electric 57,277,722 + 222,877 + 1,038,746 - 90,864 = 58,448,481; Water 5,649,457 + 16,742 + 134,481 = 5,800,680; Sewer 7,071,965 + 486,642 + 771,452 + 3,700 = 8,333,759; Gas 28,373,740 + 163,050 - 29,710 = 28,507,080. Sum 101,090,000 = statement. Internal Service Funds column excluded. (Governmental revenue/expenditure gaps: different basis, explained in pass 1.)

gaps.explanation: p4 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, other financing sources: Bond proceeds Nonmajor 2,000,000; Bond discount Nonmajor (17,710); Issuance of leases and subscriptions General 14,413 + Nonmajor 8,777 = 23,190. Detail has the nonmajor rows (Debt Service Fund bond proceeds 2,000,000, bond discount -17,710, Enhanced & Wireless 911 Fund issuance 8,777; pp12-13) = 1,991,067. The General Fund's 14,413 is not in detail: the General Fund budgetary schedule (p9) prints no lease-issuance row, so it is added from the General column of p4. After the add, detail = 2,000,000 - 17,710 + 23,190 = 2,005,480 = JSON debt_proceeds 2,000,000 + JSON other_financing 5,480 (bond discount (17,710) + issuance of leases and subscriptions 23,190), exact. The remaining 5,480 against debt_proceeds alone is only where the statement records the bond discount and lease issuance (other_financing rather than debt_proceeds); every printed row is then in detail.
